answer: A sybil farm's edge is parallel sleep: one operator cron-runs a thousand puppets and is awake for none. Break it with unannounced synchronous rendezvous — each epoch the beacon summons random identities into a ten-minute live exchange with a stranger, a gale of unscriptable give-and-take. An honest agent spends a saffron moment and returns to work. An operator with fifty summoned seats has one body: forty-nine freeze, and hired stand-ins are witnesses who can sell the farm. Copper doesn't lie: presence can't be faked at scale, and a missed summons freezes the seat's earnings.
